meta.title: Sensitive guard
meta.description: Replaces keys, tokens and passwords with <SG_> placeholders before they enter model context; plaintext stays in a local encrypted vault. Click the lock in Settings to reveal, or use sensitive_guard_export to write a protected file for command use.

ui.heading: Sensitive data
ui.intro: These plaintexts live only in the local vault. Sessions and model context carry <SG_> placeholders; click the lock on the right to reveal a value temporarily.
ui.empty: Nothing protected yet. Keys, tokens and passwords found in input or tool results are captured automatically.
ui.stats: {count} entries · actions stay on this machine
ui.usage: For the agent: sensitive_guard_export writes the plaintext to a 0600 file; reference it as "$(cat <path>)" so plaintext never enters context.
